name: Tetsuox
source: A student at the Umamichi Academy, the infamous delinquent school, and the muscle of the Kabukicho Outlaws. Tetsuox's meeting with the Protagonist turns them into an inseparable pair, with the blunt and honest Tetsuox vows to venture into the dangers side by side, hoping that once their lives come to an end they will be forever together in the world after life.
